newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Household Intl LEAPS on Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Household Intl LEAPS on Jan 20.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Tuesday it would list long term equity anticipation securities (LEAPS) on shares of Household International Inc on January 20.
The exchange said the LEAPS would open with strike prices of 70, 90 and 110, with expirations in January 1998 and January 1999.
In afternoon trading, shares of the financial services business were up 1-3/4 at 92.
Highland Securities Co would be the specialist unit for the new options, the AMEX said.
